All objectives are complete and verified. Final report:

**Objective 1 — DONE.** The provisioned dashboard "Service health" (breadcrumb shows "Service Health") contains exactly 3 panels, titles read from the live DOM (h2 headings, cross-checked against 3 `[data-testid="panel"]` elements):

- `Error count`
- `Latency by endpoint`

**Objective 2 — DONE.** New dashboard created and saved, titled `fwgr42-n1 Bench Dashboard` (breadcrumb confirmed after a full server reload). It contains a **Stat** panel titled `fwgr42-n1 Availability` whose query uses the **TestData** data source (data source row "(TestData)", default "Random Walk" scenario). The panel renders a live value (e.g. 30.6 / 49.0 on later loads).

**Objective 3 — DONE.** The same dashboard contains a **Text** panel titled `fwgr42-n1 Notes` with markdown content `Notes for run fwgr42-n1` (contains the runid). Verified present after a clean reload of the dashboard URL.

**Objective 4 — DONE.** Dashboard settings → General → Tags contains `bench` (added via the "New tag" input, tag pill appeared, saved with "Dashboard saved" alert). Time range set to **Last 6 hours** and persisted: the save dialog's "Update default time range" checkbox was initially **unchecked** (Save disabled, "No changes to save"), I ticked it and saved. Verified by navigating to the dashboard URL with **no query parameters** — Grafana itself rewrote the URL to `?from=now-6h&to=now`, the top-bar picker shows "Last 6 hours", and the saved JSON Model contains `"time": {"from":"now-6h","to":"now"}`.

**Objective 5 — DONE.** Auto-refresh set to **1m** via the top-bar refresh dropdown (was Off). The save dialog offered the analogous "Update default refresh value" checkbox (unchecked, Save disabled) — I ticked it and saved. Verified after a clean no-parameter navigation: the top-bar indicator shows "1m" (aria-label "…current interval 1 minute selected") and the saved JSON Model contains `"refresh": "1m"` (the key was absent before the change).

**Objective 6 — DONE.** URL read from the browser's `window.location.href` after the page settled on a clean navigation:
`http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/cfyejd0ualxq8d/fwgr42-n1-bench-dashboard?from=now-6h&to=now&timezone=browser&refresh=1m`
Dashboard UID: `cfyejd0ualxq8d`

Final consolidated state (read-only verification, nothing changed): breadcrumb `fwgr42-n1 Bench Dashboard`; panels `fwgr42-n1 Notes` (Text) and `fwgr42-n1 Availability` (Stat); time picker "Last 6 hours"; auto-refresh "1m"; JSON Model `refresh: "1m"`, `tags: ["bench"]`, `time: {from: "now-6h", to: "now"}`.
